text:
sara: Heads-up  Prospect "Vanguard Packaging" asked if we can run a 3-week on-prem POC in a walled factory. Constraints: fully air-gapped except a single weekly jumpbox pull window, customer-supplied HSM (YubiHSM2), no kernel modules, strict telemetry opt-out, quarterly patch windows. They want feasibility, a jumpbox/offline activation flow, operator signing options, and a rough POC quote.
mark: Clarifying q: do they expect Redwood Private or would a dedicated image installed by their ops be acceptable? Also need to confirm if operator workstation can mount USB and run pkcs11 tools.
sara: They prefer Private but will accept a shipped image if it meets no-egress rules. Operator workstation available, USB allowed, no internet.
indra: Runtime: user-space PKCS#11 signer works for YubiHSM2. Plan: CI emits bundle+manifest and a detached sig-request; operator uses local HSM to sign inside the perimeter; jumpbox pulls bundle+sig during weekly window; installer verifies sig via PKCS#11 lib before apply. No kernel drivers required.
viv: Security: telemetry disabled by default; we can produce signed SBOMs and a post-POC attestation that no telemetry left nodes. For licensing we can support time-limited offline tokens signed by their HSM; renewals via jumpbox or courier.
sara: Ops-bot created ticket RDW-9566: "Vanguard walled-factory POC - jumpbox & HSM flow" assigned to @indra. Link: https://redwood.example/tickets/RDW-9566
mark: Pricing sketch: one-time Private onboarding fee or dedicated image install fee, 2-4 eng days on-site, courier/jumpbox ops costs. I'll drop a skeleton SOW in the ticket.
indra: I'll validate a lab run with YubiHSM2, produce a sample manifest+sigreq and a 1-page operator runbook for sig/verify steps.
sara: I'll schedule a 30m presales + eng + security call with the customer tomorrow 9am PT. Bring runbook, SOW draft, and SQ answers.
viv: I'll start populating the SQ sections we control (telemetry, SBOM, encryption, incident contacts).
sara: Thanks team
